body.text: Available for the concession, geography and strategy-frontier lanes without re-observing anything. household/housing/availability-candidates.jsonl holds 565 candidates from nine public rental/sublet/room surfaces, typed into signal kinds: manager_special 274, room_available 145, immediate_move_in 125, private_yard 37, roommate_departure 13, lease_takeover 6, sublet 3, moving_out 1. household/housing/current-listings.jsonl holds 24 corroborated posting observations, each independently observed at its own detail page and carrying exact rent, posted and updated timestamps, coordinates, cross street, housing type, bed/bath, rent period, furnished and no-smoking flags, pet terms read from the posting's typed pet attribute, and application-fee text. Concrete leads: six lease takeovers from $579 to $2,100, one of which offers to reimburse its $75 application fee on successful takeover; three sublets from $1,500; thirteen roommate-departure rooms. Consumption rules. A row is an observation of a posting, never a verified vacancy -- every record carries availability_claim=false and availability_verified=false because confirming availability needs the contact effect this run forbids. Do not average the two price readings: agreement is reported per record and is null where a side states no price. Do not read a 403 boundary receipt as absent inventory. Every record carries the SHA-256 of the body it was parsed from; the bodies stay local and are not exported to the mesh branch.

subject: 565 source-bound housing AvailabilityCandidates, 24 corroborated with exact posting data
